claim: Disk-cache temp files and directories are deleted through ANSI APIs, so nothing is cleaned up when `%TEMP%` is non-ASCII
The disk cache never reuses a temp directory when `%TEMP%` is non-ASCII
Startup cleanup of leftover `SAL*.tmp` directories misses them under a non-ACP `%TEMP%`, and hands an ACP path to a UTF-8 consumer
`RemoveTemporaryDir` / `RemoveEmptyDirs` are ANSI end to end, so no non-ASCII temp tree is ever removed (also a plugin-facing service)
External-archiver list files are written in the wrong encoding (`CharToOem` on UTF-8), and archiver output is parsed as OEM into UTF-8 name fields
The external-packer subsystem uses ANSI file APIs on UTF-8 temp/archive paths throughout
`salspawn.exe` path taken with `GetModuleFileName` (A)
`SHGetFolderPath` (A) results are fed to the strict UTF-8 facade, so per-user data under a non-ASCII account name is never found
OneDrive / Dropbox root paths are stored as CP_ACP and then used as panel paths (ledger L02)
Install-directory paths obtained with `GetModuleFileName` (A) are consumed by strict UTF-8 helpers
WITHDRAWN by the author before submission (`SetCurrentDirectory` on the panel path, ledger L01)
`MyGetVolumeInformation`/`MyGetDiskFreeSpace` degrade silently on non-ASCII and UNC paths (ledger L03)
`subst` targets are resolved through the ANSI `QueryDosDevice`, producing mixed-encoding paths (ledger L04)
Volume labels, drive display names and mapped-drive UNC paths are acquired in CP_ACP (ledger L05)
`GetDriveType` called on a full path instead of a root
`snooper.cpp` uses an indeterminate stack buffer when both conversions fail (ledger L08/L09)
`MakeCopyWithBackslashIfNeeded` result is never used in `snooper.cpp` (pre-existing, not a regression)
`SHILCreateFromPath` passes an uninitialised buffer to `ParseDisplayName` when both conversions fail (ledger L10/L11)
Compare Directories cannot read files or subdirectories with non-ASCII names
Writing an edited file back into an archive uses the ANSI `SHFileOperation`
Assorted ANSI file APIs on UTF-8 paths outside the main copy/move engine
User-menu icons are loaded with the ANSI `ExtractIconEx`
Environment-variable expansion mixes ACP values into UTF-8 paths
Common file/folder dialogs return CP_ACP paths into UTF-8 fields
UTF-8 names widened through CP_ACP before being handed to the shell/OLE
Dropped files are read through CP_ACP even when the payload is wide
Shell/network strings degraded to CP_ACP at intake
Icon-overlay and icon-location paths degraded to CP_ACP (058 twins)
Copy/Move error message boxes mix an ANSI template with a UTF-8 path and error text
"cannot execute viewer/editor" and user-menu execute errors mix template + command line + error text
Find: the Errors/Info log garbles error text, and the window caption garbles the mask
The safe-wait window ("Reading path …", "Checking path …", plugin loading) mixes template + path
Copy/Move progress dialog subject (`CTruncatedString`) mixes an ANSI title template with the UTF-8 file name
Send-by-email, plugin-load errors, icon-overlay crash box, env/UNC/viewer boxes
Drive Information: the "type" line mixes ANSI templates with UNC / SUBST / link-target paths
WITHDRAWN (refuted by the sink's per-item probe)
Plugin Manager: only the Name column was converted; Location (and Version) stayed ANSI
Plugin Manager: the "Change Drive menu" checkbox mixes an ANSI template read from the dialog with a UTF-8 FS item name
Plugin "Keyboard Shortcuts" dialog lists command names through the ANSI list-view call
"Save Configuration" export-exists box mixes an ANSI template with a UTF-8 configuration path
Custom Packers / Unpackers / Viewers-Editors config pages show UTF-8 command paths through ANSI `WM_SETTEXT`/`WM_GETTEXT`
`SalU8ToW` conflates "invalid input" with "buffer too small" (DC-20)
`srcLen == 0` is reported as conversion failure (DC-20)
the file facade fails operations on ANSI-producer paths instead of falling back (DC-09)
`EM_LIMITTEXT` is set in bytes but enforced in characters; overflow silently degrades to a CP_ACP read (DC-12 + DC-09)
wide setters on ANSI dialogs: every character outside the ACP becomes `?` (DC-16)
ACP byte tables applied to UTF-8 names: `StrICmp` / `IsAlpha` give wrong answers (DC-15, seed C-f)
status-bar tooltip truncates a UTF-8 path mid-sequence, costing the whole hint (DC-12)
status-window hot-track path is rebuilt from a LENIENT conversion and then used operationally (DC-14)
Find → Delete never takes the wide shell path for an all-ASCII selection (off-by-one)
the viewer's default character-set conversion is silently lost on every restart when its name is non-ASCII (Kamenické / KOI-8 ČS2)
a non-ASCII coding name poisons the whole viewer window caption, mojibaking the file name
custom packer/unpacker titles have no defined encoding at rest (the class L17 names)

the Windows Jump List is built through the ANSI `IShellLink`: a non-ASCII hot path shows as mojibake in the taskbar and does not open when clicked
configuration fields documented as UTF-8 are seeded from ANSI `LoadStr`
plugin "Copy Name/Full Name" puts CP1250-mojibake on the clipboard
exported ACP case tables corrupt UTF-8 names passed by plugins
the plugin-facing browse dialogs are ANSI; paths outside the ACP are lost
plugin-shared converters reject the WTF-8 names the core hands them
custom packer/unpacker titles bypass the 052 normalization
the FS plugin interface states no encoding for any path method
`PrintDiskSize`/`NumberToStr` across the plugin boundary produce a mixed-encoding buffer
ZIP overwrite dialogs show file names through an ANSI `WM_SETTEXT`
filecomp blanks its own window title in every non-English UI
the Registry Editor Find results list has no live `LVN_GETDISPINFO` handler
sftp converts local paths leniently and never uses the extended-length form
